title: Zeus Juice The Black ICE Eliquid 50ml Shortfill
description: The Black Ice is an eliquid from Zeus that’s an expertly blended balance of rich, dark berries and tart blackcurrants over a beguiling base of aniseed and menthol for a touch of fire and ice. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
